---
title: Meaningful Release Titles and Structured Notes
---

## Overview

This release adds a deterministic way to prepare clear Release titles and summaries before a version tag is created.

## Highlights

- Declare a version-specific Release title and description together in committed metadata.
- Use merged pull request declarations or a single related pull request when no version metadata exists.
- Validate and carry the same title, notes, and source information through tag creation and Draft Release verification.
